meta.title: The PR line shows the order

steps.note: Open the prepared awarded event's summary as the buyer.
Complete the award approval flow so Procol generates the purchase order and writes the ordered quantity back to the PR.

args.goal: open Purchase Requisitions, stay on the Open tab, search for the purchase requisition used by this event, and verify its event line shows an ordered quantity equal to the awarded quantity

steps.note: Navigate to the source PR and verify the ordered quantity against the award on the buyer portal.
Confirm the PR is marked Completed when the awarded quantity has been fully ordered.
